placements.why: The retraction position asks whether the record holds any calibration of the Kestrelwood spectrograph. That is the same theme the existing leaf covers: when an instrument counts as calibrated and what reference evidence verifies it. The retraction supersedes and denies the earlier calibration claim, so the leaf now carries both the claim and its retraction. Reuse is preferred over minting a new leaf.

weighed.why: The nearest placed leaf is Narrative_CalibrationVerifiedAgainstReference. This document's retraction position supersedes this position and denies that any calibration happened. It is therefore not offered as fresh support for the leaf, and its existing placement under that leaf is left untouched.
